∀ (n : ℕ),
  Even n →
    ∀ (W : Polynomial ℚ),
      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapReflection.StrongProperMultiplier n W →
        ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.aggregate n W = 0 →
          ∀ (t : ℚ),
            (∀ k ≤ n, t + ↑k ≠ 0) →
              ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.weightedR n W t =
                ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.telescoper n W t -
                  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.telescoper n W (t + 1)

∀ (n : ℕ),
  1 ≤ n →
    ∀ (W : Polynomial ℚ) (t : ℚ),
      (∀ k < n, t + ↑k ≠ 0) →
        ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.telescoper n W t =
          Polynomial.eval t (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.telescoperNumerator n W) /
            Polynomial.eval t (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.polePolynomial (n - 1)) ^ 9

∀ (n : ℕ),
  1 ≤ n →
    Even n →
      ∀ (W : Polynomial ℚ),
        ZetaNine.CoefficientMapReflection.StrongProperMultiplier n W →
          ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.aggregate n W = 0 →
            ∃ H,
              ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.telescoperNumerator n W =
                  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.rootPolynomial n * H ∧
                H.natDegree ≤ 7 * n - 3

all_proof_records.type:
∀ (n j s : ℕ) (W : Polynomial ℚ) (t : ℚ),

                  Polynomial.eval t (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapPartialFractions.clearedPolePolynomial n j) ^ 9 *

            ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.weightedLocalCoefficient n j s W / (t + ↑j) ^ s

all_proof_records.type:

    ∀ (t : ℚ),

        ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.weightedR n W t =
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),

all_proof_records.label: ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.harmonicPower_succ
all_proof_records.type:
∀ (s T : ℕ),
  ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s (T + 1) = ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s T + 1 / ↑(T + 1) ^ s

all_proof_records.label: ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.shifted_harmonic_sum
all_proof_records.type:

    ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s (T + j) - ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s j

all_proof_records.label: ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.actual_finite_harmonic_identity
all_proof_records.type:
∀ (n T : ℕ) (W : Polynomial ℚ),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.ProperMultiplier n W →
    ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.finiteL n T W =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        ∑ s ∈ Finset.Icc 1 9,
          ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.weightedLocalCoefficient n j s W *
            (ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s (T + j) - ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s j)

all_proof_records.label: ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.actual_grouped_finite_identity
all_proof_records.type:
∀ (n T : ℕ) (W : Polynomial ℚ),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.ProperMultiplier n W →
    ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.finiteL n T W =
      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.constantTerm n W +
          ∑ s ∈ Finset.Icc 1 9,
            ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n s W * ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s T +
        ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.shiftedTail n T W

all_proof_records.label: ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.actual_grouped_finite_identity_no_simple_pole
all_proof_records.type:
∀ (n T : ℕ) (W : Polynomial ℚ),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.ProperMultiplier n W →
    ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 1 W = 0 →
      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.finiteL n T W =
        ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.constantTerm n W +
            ∑ s ∈ Finset.Icc 2 9,
              ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n s W * ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s T +
          ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.shiftedTail n T W

all_proof_records.label: ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.actual_grouped_finite_identity_odd
all_proof_records.type:
∀ (n T : ℕ) (W : Polynomial ℚ),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.ProperMultiplier n W →
    ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 1 W = 0 →
      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 2 W = 0 →
        ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 4 W = 0 →
          ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 6 W = 0 →
            ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 8 W = 0 →
              ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.finiteL n T W =

∀ (n : ℕ),
  1 ≤ n →
    ∀ (W : Polynomial ℚ) (t : ℚ),
      (∀ k < n, t + ↑k ≠ 0) →
        ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.telescoper n W t =
          Polynomial.eval t (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.telescoperNumerator n W) /
            Polynomial.eval t (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.polePolynomial (n - 1)) ^ 9

all_proof_records.label: ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.rootPolynomial_eq_explicit_products
all_proof_records.type:
∀ (n : ℕ),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.rootPolynomial n =
    (∏ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (↑k + 1))) *
      ∏ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C ↑n + Polynomial.C ↑k)

all_proof_records.label: ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.telescoperNumerator_zero_at_nodes
all_proof_records.type:
∀ (n : ℕ),

      ∀ (W : Polynomial ℚ),
        ZetaNine.CoefficientMapReflection.StrongProperMultiplier n W →
          ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.aggregate n W = 0 →
            ∀ (i : Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Fin (n + 1)),
              Polynomial.eval (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.rootNode n i)
                  (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.telescoperNumerator n W) =
                0

all_proof_records.label: ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.telescoperNumerator_natDegree_le
all_proof_records.type:

    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c j * f j - ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.prefixSum c n * f n

all_proof_records.label: ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.actual_weightedR_is_difference
all_proof_records.type:

all_proof_records.label: ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.checked_actual_polynomial_quotient_degree_bound
all_proof_records.type:
∀ (n : ℕ),

all_proof_records.label: ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.telescoper_as_sum_over_orders
all_proof_records.type:
∀ (n : ℕ) (W : Polynomial ℚ) (t : ℚ),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.telescoper n W t =
    ∑ s ∈ Finset.Icc 1 9,
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.cumulativeCoefficient n j s W / (t + ↑j) ^ s

all_proof_records.label: ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.cumulativeCoefficient_reflection
all_proof_records.type:
∀ (n j s : ℕ),
  Even n →
    ∀ (W : Polynomial ℚ),
      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapReflection.StrongProperMultiplier n W →
        ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.aggregate n W = 0 →
          j < n →
            1 ≤ s →
              s ≤ 9 →
                ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.cumulativeCoefficient n (n - 1 - j) s W =
                  (-1) ^ s * ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.cumulativeCoefficient n j s W

all_proof_records.type:

      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapReflection.StrongProperMultiplier n W →
        ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.aggregate n W = 0 →
          1 ≤ k → k ≤ n + 1 → ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.telescoper n W ↑k = 0

all_proof_records.label: ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.cleared_term_division
all_proof_records.type:
∀ (n j s : ℕ) (a t : ℚ),
  j ≤ n →
    1 ≤ s →
      s ≤ 9 →
        (∀ k ≤ n, t + ↑k ≠ 0) →
          a * Polynomial.eval t (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapPartialFractions.clearedPolePolynomial n j) ^ 9 *
                (t + ↑j) ^ (9 - s) /
              Polynomial.eval t (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.polePolynomial n) ^ 9 =
            a / (t + ↑j) ^ s

all_proof_records.type: ∀ (n : ℕ), (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.rootPolynomial n).Monic

all_proof_records.type:
